_meta.title: ClearStreak recovery affirmations (864zeros-authored, derived from AA 1939, public domain)
_meta.policy: Each affirmation is original 864zeros writing — authored, not quoted — but is a faithful interpretation of one specific Big Book passage and carries that passage's exact source provenance. Secular / technique-only voice: no mandatory faith, no moralizing, gender-neutral, 'use / act on the urge' rather than 'drink' where the idea is substance-agnostic. Twelve Steps are never distilled into an affirmation.
_meta.voice: Motivational, plain, second-person, poet's economy. Abstracted: each statement stands alone with only its own context plus its source reference. See _src/AFFIRMATIONS_STYLE.md.
_meta.source_format: Mirrors passages_core.json: book / chapter_id / chapter_title / page / paragraph_index / quote_stub.
